title: Design System: SAFECHAIN 安全鏈 — Forged Link by Link

display.purpose: Hero and contact finale only. 6rem hard ceiling.

headline.purpose: Section h2s and catalog row names.

serif-accent.purpose: One italic counter-signature phrase per fold, never more.

body.purpose: Prose at Ink Body color, 44–65ch measure.

label.purpose: Mono micro-labels, catalog codes, spec strips. Data voice only.

zh-display.purpose: Noto Sans TC 900 replaces Archivo for display when lang is zh-Hant; tracking +0.02em, leading 1.18.

shadows.name: state-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover feedback on solid-filled buttons only; never on hairline-bordered elements.

motion.name: ease-out-expo-ish
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition and reveal.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll entrance; armed only when html.js is present so no-JS renders stay visible.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Kinetic strip between hero and manifesto.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill that certifies the main action; hovers to Deep Seal Vermilion with a state lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 16px 28px; border: 1px solid #131410; border-radius: 999px; background: #131410; color: #F4F3EE; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B0300F; border-color: #B0300F; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(19,20,16,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8492B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined pill for the secondary path; hovers to full ink inversion.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 16px 28px; border: 1px solid #131410; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #131410; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #131410; color: #F4F3EE; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8492B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Mono underlined micro-link; hovers to Deep Seal Vermilion.
components.css: .ds-text-link { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: #131410; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #131410; padding: 8px 0 3px; transition: color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #B0300F; border-color: #B0300F; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8492B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: Signature hairline list row: vermilion code, headline name, mono tags, arrow. Hover inverts to ink and shifts content.

components.css: .ds-cap-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1.3fr 1fr 32px; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 24px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #13141024; border-bottom: 1px solid #13141024; text-decoration: none; color: #131410; transition: background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.35s; } .ds-cap-row:hover { background: #131410; color: #F4F3EE; } .ds-cap-idx { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #B0300F; transition: transform 0.35s, color 0.35s; } .ds-cap-row:hover .ds-cap-idx { color: #E8492B; transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-cap-name { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112, 'wght' 740; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.35s; } .ds-cap-row:hover .ds-cap-name { transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-cap-tags { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #1314109E; transition: color 0.35s, transform 0.35s; } .ds-cap-row:hover .ds-cap-tags { color: #F4F3EE99; transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-cap-arrow { font-size: 1.3rem; justify-self: end; transition: transform 0.35s, color 0.35s; } .ds-cap-row:hover .ds-cap-arrow { transform: translateX(6px); color: #E8492B; }

components.name: Method Card
components.description: Hairline card for the three method gates; hover darkens the border and raises the porcelain.
components.html:
M·02

Test to failure

components.description: Proof number with vermilion superscript and mono label.

components.name: Spec Strip
components.description: The certificate's margin data: mono microdata separated by dots.
components.css: .ds-spec { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; border-top: 1px solid #13141024; padding: 16px 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1314109E; } .ds-spec i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #13141024; }

narrative.overview: Every surface behaves like a calibrated laboratory document: measured, stated, and signed off. Nothing decorates; everything attests. The porcelain page is the certificate paper, ink is the recorded data, and Seal Vermilion is the certifier's mark — rare, deliberate, and always meaning 'this has been verified.' The register is brand, but the voice is a lab that happens to be beautiful: proof over adjectives, strength through restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain-white field with near-black ink; one vermilion voice used like a certifier’s seal
Wide variable grotesque (Archivo wdth 116) does the talking; serif italic interjects; mono records
Depth is drawn, not cast: hairlines, tonal shifts, and one full ink inversion at the finale
Motion is quiet and exponential; every animation has a reduced-motion fallback
WCAG AA is a floor, not a target

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Seal Vermilion appears only where something is being attested — an index, a proof point, a focus, a hover. It never exceeds roughly 5% of a viewport, and #E8492B never sets type smaller than 18px on light; small vermilion text is always Deep Seal Vermilion.

rules.name: The No-Pure Rule
rules.body: Pure #000 and #FFF are forbidden. The warm ink/porcelain pair is the brand's material.

rules.name: The Three-Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo states, Instrument Serif reflects, Space Grotesk records. No voice borrows another's job, and no fourth voice enters.

rules.name: The Width-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Impact comes from the wdth axis and weight, never from exceeding the 6rem ceiling or tightening tracking past -0.025em.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No element casts a shadow at rest. State shadows stay at or under 8px blur and never attach to hairline-bordered elements — a border is a drawing, a shadow is a light source, and an element gets one or the other.

dos: Do hold every text/background pair to WCAG AA: 4.5:1 minimum for small text (Ink Muted #1314109E is the floor), 3:1 for large display.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines and tonal porcelain shifts before reaching for any other device.
Do keep Seal Vermilion scarce — if vermilion exceeds ~5% of a viewport, it is no longer a seal.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and keep easing on the exponential family (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)).
Do keep the bilingual accents (安全鏈, 台灣・精工) — identity, not decoration.
donts: Don't produce "generic corporate B2B": template heroes, stock handshake photos, blue-gradient trust badges.
Don't produce "flashy SaaS startup": gradient glows, floating glass cards, hero metrics, dark-purple everything.
Don't produce a "dense industrial catalog": spec-table walls and part numbers with no story or craft.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe borders, or numbered eyebrow labels above sections — catalog codes (S·01) and the three method gates (M·01–03) are the only sanctioned numbering.
Don't exceed the 6rem display ceiling or pair a 1px border with a cast shadow on the same element.
Don't let placeholder statistics ship as fact: every number on the page is unverified until the real business replaces it.
